nodes.label: Cloud Sync (Supabase)
nodes.rationale: Optional cross-device sync via hand-rolled fetch-based PostgREST client, gated by SUPABASE_ENABLED; last-write-wins, dbReady gates all cloud writes so a device that never read cloud can't overwrite newer data.

nodes.label: Demo Sandbox
nodes.rationale: Lets an admin practice on a disposable copy of the whole workspace, isolated by physical localStorage key prefix (physKey) rather than a mode flag inside shared code.

nodes.label: Pre-authorization Email Allowlist
nodes.rationale: Allowlisted address lands in admin role on first login instead of pending; keyed off auth.jwt() email never client-controlled new.email, so nobody can spoof an allowlisted address.

nodes.label: Server-side Domain Restriction
nodes.rationale: Client-side LoginScreen check alone is insufficient; restrict_signup_domain SQL hook wired to a Before-User-Created Auth Hook enforces it server-side.

nodes.label: RLS as Security Boundary
nodes.rationale: UI gates are convenience only; RLS is the real boundary. role='pending' must be enforced in RLS policies, not just the client branch, after a real impersonation hole was found.

nodes.label: Generator Quality Harness (best-of-N + repair)
nodes.rationale: generateSchedule is greedy/nondeterministic; generateScheduleBest runs 20 seeded attempts scored via a lexicographic tuple (never a weighted scalar) plus one bounded repair pass, picking the strict best.

nodes.label: SCORE_WEIGHTS Tier Audit
nodes.rationale: Every score() weight extracted into one table classified STRUCTURAL vs PREFERENCE. A real arithmetic inversion exists (preference bands up to 40 exceed the smallest structural weight of 15) but is inert because candidatePool's allAtTarget filter enforces fairness upstream; rescaling was A/B tested and rejected since it did not move deficitSpread.

nodes.label: Work-Shape Scoring
nodes.rationale: General-purpose complement to nightShapePenalty; penalizes scattered shifts, area churn, and vacation-adjacency. Fragmentation is measured against ceil(worked/maxConsecutiveWorkDays), not the night convention, because MAX_CONSECUTIVE_WORK_DAYS=6 makes multiple runs legally mandatory.

nodes.label: AY-to-Date Fairness Carryover
nodes.rationale: Re-measures deficit/night/weekend spread over published-snapshot history capped at 6 blocks so a resident hammered last block doesn't start even; strict no-op on empty history, and no-history residents are excluded rather than zeroed to avoid hammering the newest hire.

nodes.label: Override Capture Loop
nodes.rationale: Records every hand-edit to a generated schedule through the single updateBlockTracked choke point; reports only, never infers a rule or auto-tunes a weight, to preserve auditability.

nodes.label: PDF Export (jspdf-autotable)
nodes.rationale: jspdf-autotable@3.8.4's default export is not callable under esbuild/Rollup bundling; fixed by importing for side effect only and always calling doc.autoTable(...) as an instance method.

nodes.label: What's New Banner
nodes.rationale: Shown once automatically because deploys are otherwise invisible to the chief; a prior UI change shipped unnoticed.

nodes.label: Dark Mode
nodes.rationale: Override stylesheet in index.css rather than Tailwind dark: variants, since the file has thousands of class strings.

nodes.label: Coverage Min/Max Model
nodes.rationale: Generator fills every shift to min first (hard), then optionally tops up toward max only for residents under their own target (soft cap, never a requirement).

nodes.label: 12-Hour Shift Windows
nodes.rationale: Backward compat is the whole design: absent twelveHourWindows falls back to implicit conference windows reproducing the old hardcoded swap exactly, so an untouched AY behaves identically to before the feature.

nodes.label: PED-N Split Into Two Shift IDs
nodes.rationale: One PED-N used to model two different real-world shifts at the wrong hours for one of them; split into PED-N (EM residents, 19:00-04:00) and PED-N-FM (FM-3 only, 23:00-08:00), which made night-to-evening-next-day legal for the first time and required widening the postNightRest circadian scan.

nodes.label: Circadian Scheduling Rules
nodes.rationale: Hard checks run in validateAll regardless of appSettings.enforceRest; that toggle only ever gated the pairwise legal-rest-hours check, matching the generator which already enforced circadian rules unconditionally.

nodes.label: Soft Rule Priority
nodes.rationale: Chief-orderable ranking of coverageMin, seniorComposition, postNightRest decides whether the generator reaches for a rest-violating/junior candidate or leaves a slot unfilled to protect a rule.

nodes.label: Journal Club Rules
nodes.rationale: Worked-JC derived from SHIFT_TIMING overlap with 18:00-21:00, not a hand-maintained shift-id list, so it automatically covers PED-S and Trauma Night; capped at 3/AY counted only across published blocks.

nodes.label: Chief-Editable Journal Club Dates
nodes.rationale: Journal Club defaults to first Tuesdays but the chief occasionally moves one, so the date list is now stored data with an explicit empty array honored as 'no JC this year'.

nodes.label: FLEX/POD Seniority Composition
nodes.rationale: FLEX seniority stays soft (chief's call); POD seniority is hard-errored in validateAll unless a Wellness-Wednesday PGY-2 substitute applies. Wednesday day shifts are exempt from both rules since Grand Rounds structurally removes every EM senior that day.

nodes.label: Wellness Wednesdays
nodes.rationale: Block-relative Nth Wednesday (not calendar month) per EM_HOME resident; every getEligibleShifts call site must pass ctx.blockStart or this silently no-ops.

nodes.label: Chief Roles
nodes.rationale: Global roster field replacing the old per-block isChief checkbox; only the academic role carries a hard rule (no Tuesday eve/night).

nodes.label: Per-Block Target Overrides (Buy-Downs)
nodes.rationale: A delta, never an absolute number, so it survives SHIFT_TARGETS changes; a delta that zeroes the target must return null not 0, since 0 != null is true and would corrupt fairness scoring.

nodes.label: Jeopardy & Sick-Call Ledger
nodes.rationale: One incident record per event with sick-call and activation counts derived from it so they can never disagree; nothing auto-applies to any target, same restraint as override capture.

nodes.label: QGenda CSV Export Rework
nodes.rationale: Chief has no QGenda admin rights and cannot trial-run, so every choice (task-name table, column-name data, per-resident staffId escape hatch) is biased toward being chief-fixable without a redeploy.

nodes.label: Rule-Default Migration (LEGACY_*_DEFAULTS)
nodes.rationale: getEffectiveDayRules replaces a key's default wholesale with any chief-saved override, so a saved override equal to the previous (pre-correction) default would silently keep masking a fix forever without this pruning mechanism.

nodes.label: Eligibility Overrides as Diff
nodes.rationale: Used to store a wholesale snapshot of the shift list, meaning a shift id added later was invisible to that override forever; a real outage happened when 12h replacement shifts could never be assigned because saved rotation overrides predated those ids. A diff has no such blind spot.
